hooks.command: [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_PERPLEXITY_API_KEY" ] || echo '{"systemMessage": "mcp-perplexity has no settings yet, so its MCP server cannot start. Since 2.0.0 it no longer reads PERPLEXITY_API_KEY from your shell. Run /plugin configure mcp-perplexity@wookstar-claude-plugins (or claude plugin configure mcp-perplexity@wookstar-claude-plugins in a terminal), then restart Claude Code."}'
